slides.headline: A GUY TOLD GROK TO DRIVE HIS TESLA. 5 COMMANDS.
1) SEND YOUR TESLA A DESTINATION WITHOUT TOUCHING IT
slides.body: He typed an address into Grok. His Tesla's navigation loaded before he laced his shoes. "Navigate my Tesla to [address] and confirm when it is set."

slides.headline: 2) CHECK YOUR BATTERY AND RANGE FROM YOUR COUCH
slides.body: One text to Grok. It replied with his exact battery percentage and miles left in seconds. "Check my Tesla's battery level and tell me my current range."

slides.headline: 3) WARM THE CABIN BEFORE YOU WALK OUT
slides.body: Text Grok the night before. You get in and it is already 72 degrees. You never touched the app. "Set my Tesla's climate to 72 degrees starting in 10 minutes."

slides.headline: 4) CHARGING STARTED. HE WASN'T EVEN HOME.
slides.body: He was at dinner. His Tesla sat in the driveway. He told Grok. Charging started. "Start charging my Tesla now."

slides.headline: 5) LOCK YOUR TESLA FROM ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD
slides.body: Left your car unlocked. One message to Grok. Done. The lock confirmation comes back in seconds. "Lock my Tesla and confirm it is secured."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 5 GROK COMMANDS FOR YOUR TESLA
slides.body:
Navigate to any address
